DCC ID: dcc:site:gosno

            <div class="block rich-text prose" >
    <p dir="auto">Discover Alaska’s glacial landscape from two perspectives with Coastal Helicopters’ Icefield Excursion in Juneau. Begin with a scenic helicopter flight over the region’s mountains and wilderness before landing on Herbert Glacier, where Coastal’s Glacier Guide Team welcomes you to explore the ice firsthand.</p>
<p dir="auto">This 2-hour, 35-minute excursion includes round-trip transportation from downtown Juneau, approximately 25–30 minutes of helicopter flightseeing, and 30–35 minutes on Herbert Glacier.</p>

  </div>

            <div class="block activity-upsell" >
    <h2 class="quick-details-header -use-headline-font">Quick Details</h2>
    <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 20px;">
<li><strong>Location:</strong> Juneau, Alaska</li>
<li><strong>Destination:</strong> Herbert Glacier</li>
<li><strong>Total Duration:</strong> 2 hours, 35 minutes (155 minutes)</li>
<li><strong>Helicopter & Glacier Experience:</strong> 60–65 minutes</li>
<li><strong>Total Flightseeing:</strong> approximately 25 minutes</li>
<li><strong>Glacier Landing:</strong> 35–40 minutes</li>
<li><strong>Ages:</strong> All ages</li>
<li><strong>Included:</strong> Round-trip transportation, helicopter flightseeing, glacier landing, and guided glacier exploration</li>
</ul>
  </div>

                        <div class="block rich-text prose" >
    <h2 dir="auto">Your Helicopter Adventure</h2>
<p dir="auto">Your excursion begins with transportation from the Goldbelt Tram area in downtown Juneau to Coastal Helicopters’ helicopter base.</p>
<p dir="auto">From there, board your helicopter for a scenic flight toward Herbert Glacier. As Juneau’s wilderness unfolds below, take in the mountains and glacial terrain from above before descending toward the ice.</p>
<p dir="auto">After approximately 12 minutes in the air, your helicopter lands on Herbert Glacier, where the next part of your adventure begins.</p>
<h3 dir="auto">Explore Herbert Glacier with Coastal’s Glacier Guide Team</h3>
<p dir="auto">Step out of the helicopter and onto the glacier, where Coastal’s Glacier Guide Team will greet you for approximately 35–40 minutes of exploration.</p>
<p dir="auto">Experience the glacier beneath your feet, photograph the surrounding landscape, and learn about Alaska’s icy environment from your guides.</p>
<p dir="auto">It’s an opportunity to experience the same landscape from two entirely different perspectives: first from the air, then standing on the glacier itself.</p>
<h3 dir="auto">Scenic Return Flight to Juneau</h3>
<p dir="auto">After your time on Herbert Glacier, reboard your helicopter for the scenic flight back to Coastal’s base. Enjoy another perspective of the surrounding landscape before returning to downtown Juneau by ground transportation.</p>
<p dir="auto">This tour is suited to cruise ship passengers and independent travelers visiting Juneau. Cruise guests should confirm that their selected tour time fits their ship’s schedule.</p>
<h3>Important Details About Your Tour</h3>
<ul>
<li>When selecting a Juneau helicopter glacier tour time; please allow yourself a <strong>45-minute buffer</strong> from when your ship arrives and leaves. It is your responsibility to book times that work with your cruise ship.</li>
<li>Cameras and cell phones are welcomed while on tour, but all <strong>drones, selfie sticks, phone stabilizers, and any camera extensions are prohibited</strong>.</li>
<li>The selected tour time is the pick-up time from the Goldbelt Tram Building (490 S. Franklin Street). This landmark will have red gondolas going up and down the mountain (it is important to note that you are NOT getting on the tram, you are just meeting at the building).</li>
<li>Coastal Helicopters will try our best to accommodate parties/families in the same helicopter. However, we cannot guarantee seating as it is all based on helicopter weight and balance, as well as the other parties within the flight. This will be determined at the time of check-in once everyone on the flight has weighed in. Should your family/party be split into multiple helicopters, the landing will happen together. Please also note that lap children are NOT allowed, and each passenger must purchase a full-fare ticket.</li>
<li>Please report <strong>proper weights fully clothed</strong> for all attending guests. Inputting improper weights or selecting the wrong passenger type can lead to <strong>rescheduling on the day of your tour</strong> or <strong>cancellation without refund</strong>.</li>
<li>Please be aware that every guest is individually weighed at our facilities.</li>
<li>If you are unable to enter and exit our aircraft on your own, you may be subject to <strong>rescheduling on the day of your tour</strong> or <strong>cancellation without refund</strong>. If you anticipate needing additional assistance at the time of tour, please contact our Reservations Team at <strong>(800) 789-5610</strong> to confirm whether our team is able to accommodate your booking request.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Our Helicopters hold up to 6 Standard Passengers. Groups of 2 or more passengers may be subject to being split amongst different aircraft to ensure the safety of all Coastal Helicopters staff and passengers while on tour.</strong></p>

          // UUID validation helper
      var isValidUuid = (function(){
        var UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-(?:[0-9a-f]{4}-){3}[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
        return function(uuid){
          return uuid && UUID_REGEX.test(uuid);

      // Helper to get UUID from localStorage
      var getUuidFromStorage = function() {
        try {
          var uuid = localStorage.getItem('fareharbor-uuid');
          if (uuid) {
            return uuid.replaceAll('"', '');
          }
        } catch(e) {}
        return '';
      };

      // Global flags for tracking identification state
      window.mixpanelIdentified = false;

      // Create a promise that resolves when UUID is available or timeout
      window.mixpanelReady = new Promise(function(resolve) {
        var timeout = window.MIXPANEL_UUID_TIMEOUT || 400;
        var pollInterval = 50;
        var elapsed = 0;

        var checkUuid = function() {
          var uuid = getUuidFromStorage();

          if (uuid && isValidUuid(uuid)) {
            // UUID found - identify and resolve
            window.mixpanel.fareharbor.identify(uuid);
            window.mixpanelIdentified = true;
            resolve();
          } else if (elapsed >= timeout) {
            // Timeout reached - resolve without identifying
            resolve();
          } else {
            // Keep polling
            elapsed += pollInterval;
            setTimeout(checkUuid, pollInterval);
          }
        };

        // Start checking
        checkUuid();
      });

Discover Alaska’s glacial landscape from two perspectives with Coastal Helicopters’ Icefield Excursion in Juneau. Begin with a scenic helicopter flight over the region’s mountains and wilderness before landing on Herbert Glacier, where Coastal’s Glacier Guide Team welcomes you to explore the ice firsthand.
This 2-hour, 35-minute excursion includes round-trip transportation from downtown Juneau, approximately 25–30 minutes of helicopter flightseeing, and 30–35 minutes on Herbert Glacier.
Quick Details
Location: Juneau, Alaska
Destination: Herbert Glacier
Total Duration: 2 hours, 35 minutes (155 minutes)
Helicopter & Glacier Experience: 60–65 minutes
Total Flightseeing: approximately 25 minutes
Glacier Landing: 35–40 minutes
Ages: All ages
Included: Round-trip transportation, helicopter flightseeing, glacier landing, and guided glacier exploration
Your Helicopter Adventure
Your excursion begins with transportation from the Goldbelt Tram area in downtown Juneau to Coastal Helicopters’ helicopter base.
From there, board your helicopter for a scenic flight toward Herbert Glacier. As Juneau’s wilderness unfolds below, take in the mountains and glacial terrain from above before descending toward the ice.
After approximately 12 minutes in the air, your helicopter lands on Herbert Glacier, where the next part of your adventure begins.
Explore Herbert Glacier with Coastal’s Glacier Guide Team
Step out of the helicopter and onto the glacier, where Coastal’s Glacier Guide Team will greet you for approximately 35–40 minutes of exploration.
Experience the glacier beneath your feet, photograph the surrounding landscape, and learn about Alaska’s icy environment from your guides.
It’s an opportunity to experience the same landscape from two entirely different perspectives: first from the air, then standing on the glacier itself.
Scenic Return Flight to Juneau
After your time on Herbert Glacier, reboard your helicopter for the scenic flight back to Coastal’s base. Enjoy another perspective of the surrounding landscape before returning to downtown Juneau by ground transportation.
This tour is suited to cruise ship passengers and independent travelers visiting Juneau. Cruise guests should confirm that their selected tour time fits their ship’s schedule.
Important Details About Your Tour
When selecting a Juneau helicopter glacier tour time; please allow yourself a 45-minute buffer from when your ship arrives and leaves. It is your responsibility to book times that work with your cruise ship.
Cameras and cell phones are welcomed while on tour, but all drones, selfie sticks, phone stabilizers, and any camera extensions are prohibited.
The selected tour time is the pick-up time from the Goldbelt Tram Building (490 S. Franklin Street). This landmark will have red gondolas going up and down the mountain (it is important to note that you are NOT getting on the tram, you are just meeting at the building).
Coastal Helicopters will try our best to accommodate parties/families in the same helicopter. However, we cannot guarantee seating as it is all based on helicopter weight and balance, as well as the other parties within the flight. This will be determined at the time of check-in once everyone on the flight has weighed in. Should your family/party be split into multiple helicopters, the landing will happen together. Please also note that lap children are NOT allowed, and each passenger must purchase a full-fare ticket.
Please report proper weights fully clothed for all attending guests. Inputting improper weights or selecting the wrong passenger type can lead to rescheduling on the day of your tour or cancellation without refund.
Please be aware that every guest is individually weighed at our facilities.
If you are unable to enter and exit our aircraft on your own, you may be subject to rescheduling on the day of your tour or cancellation without refund. If you anticipate needing additional assistance at the time of tour, please contact our Reservations Team at (800) 789-5610 to confirm whether our team is able to accommodate your booking request.
Our Helicopters hold up to 6 Standard Passengers. Groups of 2 or more passengers may be subject to being split amongst different aircraft to ensure the safety of all Coastal Helicopters staff and passengers while on tour.

          <ul>
<li aria-level="2">Cancellations made at least 7 days prior to a scheduled tour will be refunded in full. Cancellations made 4 – 6 days prior to a scheduled tour will be charged 50%. Cancellations within 3 days of your scheduled tour will not be refunded.</li>
<li aria-level="2">Cancellations must be confirmed via e-mail or phone with a Coastal employee.</li>
<li aria-level="2">If Coastal Helicopters cancels a flight due to weather or flight schedule delay, the passenger will be refunded in full.  If the Cruise Line cancels your sailing, misses the port completely or is late and we are unable to reschedule you, the passenger will be refunded in full. Decisions to fly are at the discretion of Coastal Helicopters, Inc.</li>
<li aria-level="2">For cancellations due to any kind of medical reason; valid documentation from either your health care provider, or the cruise ship’s doctor, must first be provided to be eligible for a refund.  If a family/party member is ill on the day of the tour, medical documentation must be provided for a refund.</li>
<li aria-level="2">Failure to comply with any cruise ship regulations, or provide required documentation, that results in you being denied boarding and not being able to cruise/take your tour, will not be refunded.</li>
<li aria-level="2">If you are traveling through Canada, or any other country, and are denied entrance due to missing or delayed travel documents or visas, and this causes you to miss your tour, you will not be refunded.</li>
<li aria-level="2">If you are traveling by air and miss your flight, you will not be refunded unless it was the fault of the airline.  You must provide documentation from them to receive a refund.</li>
<li aria-level="2">Want a more flexible cancellation plan? Add<a href="#trip-protection"> trip protection</a> to your booking.</li>

        <li hidden class="prose section-content js-section-content
          
        ">
          <ul>
<li aria-level="2">The weather in Juneau is very unique as there are what many consider “microclimates.” This is largely due to the number of valleys, mountains, temperate temperatures from the ocean waters, and freezing temperatures from the glacier. This means that the weather is quite unpredictable, and it can drastically vary from downtown where the cruise ships are to the valley where our glacier is located.</li>
<li aria-level="2">When it comes to cancellation decisions, it is quite rare that we will outright cancel the day. Just as the weather is so varied across locations, it also can change quite rapidly. We will do our best to make decisions close to your pick up time, but please understand that this is not always possible. If the weather is marginal, we promise as soon as we have made a decision to not fly, we will be in touch with you.</li>
<li aria-level="2">Juneau is located in a temperate rainforest, this means that many of our tours are done in the rain. But, don’t worry! The grey skies in conjunction with the rain, provides a great and very true Alaskan experience.</li>
<li aria-level="2">If we do have to make the unfortunate decision to cancel your tour, we will do our best to reschedule you to any space we have available. If this is not possible, rest assured you will be fully refunded.</li>
<li aria-level="2">
<div>Weather conditions can change rapidly in and around the Juneau Icefield.   In rare instances, passengers may be temporarily delayed on the glacier due to weather.  If this occurs, our team will be in constant communication with Cruise Line Agencies and our Management team to get you safely back as soon as conditions allow.  If this occurs and your cruise ship has already left the port of Juneau, Coastal Helicopters will provide support to return you to the next port of arrival.</div>
<div></div>
</li>
</ul>

    if ($('body').hasClass('post-password-protected')) {
    const postId = $('body').data('post-id');
    $.post('https://coastalhelicopters.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php', {
      action: 'password-protected',
      postId: postId,
    }, function(response) {
      let url = new URL(document.location.href);
      let params = new URLSearchParams(url.search);

      if (response) {
        // Post is authed, send to the cached auth version
        params.set('auth', response);
      } else {
        // Post is NOTH authed, remove the param
        params.delete('auth');
      }

      if([...params].length) {
        url = `${location.pathname}?${params}`;
      } else {
        url = location.pathname;
      }

      window.history.replaceState({}, '', url);
    });
  }

        return function(uuid){

            return uuid.replaceAll('"', '');
          }
        } catch(e) {}
        return '';

      // Global flags for tracking identification state
      window.mixpanelIdentified = false;

      // Create a promise that resolves when UUID is available or timeout
      window.mixpanelReady = new Promise(function(resolve) {
        var timeout = window.MIXPANEL_UUID_TIMEOUT || 400;
        var pollInterval = 50;
        var elapsed = 0;

        var checkUuid = function() {
          var uuid = getUuidFromStorage();

          if (uuid && isValidUuid(uuid)) {
            // UUID found - identify and resolve
            window.mixpanel.fareharbor.identify(uuid);
            window.mixpanelIdentified = true;
            resolve();
          } else if (elapsed >= timeout) {
            // Timeout reached - resolve without identifying
            resolve();
          } else {
            // Keep polling
            elapsed += pollInterval;
            setTimeout(checkUuid, pollInterval);
          }
        };

        // Start checking
        checkUuid();
      });

FAQs
Got Questions? We’ve Got Answers!
Will you pick us up from our cruise ship?
All passengers coming off of a cruise ship are picked up from the Goldbelt Tram Building (490 S. Franklin St.). Our dock representatives will be standing on the street side of this red building, standing underneath the cables going up the mountain.
What is the earliest tour I can book?
If you are arriving via cruise ship, you will need at least 45 minutes from the time your cruise ship docks to the start of your tour time.
Will I make it back to my ship before my all aboard?
We have a reservations team that works tirelessly to ensure your reservation will get you back to your cruise ship in time. If you selected a time that does not work for your cruise ship, we will get in touch to find an alternative.
If for some reason our operation is running late, and it would end up pushing your tour end time passed your all aboard we will unfortunately have to cancel your booking, but you will be fully refunded.
While we strive to keep everything running smoothly, weather conditions—especially on the glacier—can change rapidly and are beyond our control. In rare instances, passengers may be temporarily delayed on the glacier due to weather. If this occurs, our team will be in constant communication with Cruise Line Agencies and our Management team to get you safely back as soon as conditions allow. If this occurs and your cruise ship has already left the port of Juneau, Coastal Helicopters will provide support to return you to the next port of arrival.
What is your cancellation policy?
Cancellations made at least 7 days prior to a scheduled tour will be refunded in full. Cancellations made 4 – 6 days prior to a scheduled tour will be charged 50%. Cancellations within 3 days of your scheduled tour will not be refunded.
Cancellations must be confirmed via e-mail or phone with a Coastal employee.
If Coastal Helicopters cancels a flight due to weather or flight schedule delay, the passenger will be refunded in full. If the Cruise Line cancels your sailing, misses the port completely or is late and we are unable to reschedule you, the passenger will be refunded in full. Decisions to fly are at the discretion of Coastal Helicopters, Inc.
For cancellations due to any kind of medical reason; valid documentation from either your health care provider, or the cruise ship’s doctor, must first be provided to be eligible for a refund. If a family/party member is ill on the day of the tour, medical documentation must be provided for a refund.
Failure to comply with any cruise ship regulations, or provide required documentation, that results in you being denied boarding and not being able to cruise/take your tour, will not be refunded.
If you are traveling through Canada, or any other country, and are denied entrance due to missing or delayed travel documents or visas, and this causes you to miss your tour, you will not be refunded.
If you are traveling by air and miss your flight, you will not be refunded unless it was the fault of the airline. You must provide documentation from them to receive a refund.
Want a more flexible cancellation plan? Add trip protection to your booking.
What is your weather policy?
The weather in Juneau is very unique as there are what many consider “microclimates.” This is largely due to the number of valleys, mountains, temperate temperatures from the ocean waters, and freezing temperatures from the glacier. This means that the weather is quite unpredictable, and it can drastically vary from downtown where the cruise ships are to the valley where our glacier is located.
When it comes to cancellation decisions, it is quite rare that we will outright cancel the day. Just as the weather is so varied across locations, it also can change quite rapidly. We will do our best to make decisions close to your pick up time, but please understand that this is not always possible. If the weather is marginal, we promise as soon as we have made a decision to not fly, we will be in touch with you.
Juneau is located in a temperate rainforest, this means that many of our tours are done in the rain. But, don’t worry! The grey skies in conjunction with the rain, provides a great and very true Alaskan experience.
If we do have to make the unfortunate decision to cancel your tour, we will do our best to reschedule you to any space we have available. If this is not possible, rest assured you will be fully refunded.
Weather conditions can change rapidly in and around the Juneau Icefield. In rare instances, passengers may be temporarily delayed on the glacier due to weather. If this occurs, our team will be in constant communication with Cruise Line Agencies and our Management team to get you safely back as soon as conditions allow. If this occurs and your cruise ship has already left the port of Juneau, Coastal Helicopters will provide support to return you to the next port of arrival.
Why do you need to know my weight?
There are a few reasons we need your weight, but the main reason is to ensure the combined weights of all passengers will work for the departure.
Helicopters have to be balanced in order to fly, and this balancing is dependent on weight
Helicopters are not spacious, so in order to ensure passengers are comfortable, we need each passenger’s weight
There is a maximum weight that can be taken per helicopter and in order to ensure your tour departure is flyable we need to know this information beforehand. We will also confirm the weights of each passenger when checking in for your flight at our base.
What is trip protection?
Adding trip protection allows you to cancel up to 3 days before your tour and receive a refund minus the cost of the trip protection and processing fees.
Cancellations made without trip protection will be subject to our standard cancellation policy.
How many people can fit in a helicopter?
Our helicopters can take up to 6 passengers, or 1240 pounds in passenger weight.
Will I be able to fly with my family?
Coastal Helicopters will try our best to accommodate parties/families in the same helicopter. However, we cannot guarantee seating as it is all based on helicopter weight and balance, as well as the other parties within the flight. This will be determined at the time of check-in once everyone on the flight has weighed in. Should your family/party be split into multiple helicopters, the landing will happen together. Please also note that lap children are NOT allowed, and each passenger must purchase a full-fare ticket.
I weigh 260+lbs, why do I have to pay more?
Due to the limited space in our aircraft, we have to reserve extra space for those weighing 260lbs or more. This fee pays for 1.5 seats.
I weigh 300+lbs, why do I have to pay more?
Due to the limited space in our aircraft, we have to reserve extra space for those weighing 300lbs or more. This fee pays for 2 full seats.
Do you only operate out of Juneau?
Yes, our operation is only based out of Juneau
What glacier do you go to?
We fly to the Herbert Glacier which is a branch of the larger Juneau Icefield
Is there an age limit?
No, we do not have any age restrictions, but we do not allow any lap seats – each passenger regardless of age must have a seat.
How cold will it be on the glacier?
The glacier can be quite chilly as it is a field of ice! When you are downtown, you can extent the glacier to be around 15-20 degrees cooler. We suggest bringing layers!
What if I have limited mobility?
If you are unable to enter and exit our aircraft on your own, you may be subject to rescheduling on the day of your tour or cancellation without refund. If you anticipate needing additional assistance at the time of the tour, please contact our Reservations Team at (800) 789-5610 or email tours@coastalhelicopters.com to confirm whether our team is able to accommodate your booking request.
Do you allow service animals?
Unfortunately, no. We are unable to accommodate service animals or animals of any nature on our tours due to limited space in the helicopter and all aircraft doors are emergency exits.
Does Coastal Helicopters partner with a third party for the dog sled adventures?
Yes, Coastal Helicopters partners with Alaska Icefield Expedition (AIE) for the Dog Sled Adventures. AIE has been operating glacier dog sled camps in Juneau and Skagway for over 24 years. To learn more about AIE, visit their website at www.alaskaicefieldexpeditions.com. All Dogsled guests will be required to sign a liability waiver before their tour. Here is a link to our liability waiver.
Flight Minimums
In order to conduct our tours, a minimum of 4 passengers must be met. If your party is 3 or less, and no other parties book into your selected departure, we may have to reschedule or cancel your tour. If we must cancel your tour due to minimums not being met, your party will be fully refunded.

              <div class="extra-content prose">
          <h2>Immerse Yourself in the Wonders of Mendenhall Glacier in Juneau</h2>
<p><strong>Take in all the beauty Southeast Alaska has to offer on this once in a life-time helicopter walking tour on the Mendenhall Glacier!</strong></p>
<p>Your tour begins with a short transfer to our comfortable and spacious heli-base. Here you will be geared up with glacier boots and given a safety briefing by our tour attendants. Load up into our state of the art helicopters and begin your bucket-list worthy adventure. Our highly-trained pilots will lift you off the ground and safely transport you over some of the most breathtaking sights you have ever seen. Lush green rainforests, alpine ridges, and glacier valleys pass beneath you as you make your way to the main attraction, the famous Mendenhall Glacier. Before touching down, you will have a birds-eye view of the awe-inspiring blue glacier ice, deep crevasses, spectacular ice falls and the jagged peaks of the Mendenhall Towers.</p>
<p>Once you have safely landed on the glacier you will be welcomed by our team of expert glacier guides. Our knowledgeable guides will take you on a tour of Mendenhall Glacier. During the 25 minutes you spend on the glacier you will learn how glaciers are formed and what makes them so spectacular. The tour will allow you to explore melt-water pools, feel glacial silt, and capture all of the beauty on your camera. The adventure isn’t over yet; join your pilot in the helicopter for a ride back to our base to take in the Alaskan beauty from the air one last time. Leaving the glacier behind you will take with you memories that will last a life-time.</p>

        </div>

<script>
    if ($('body').hasClass('post-password-protected')) {
    const postId = $('body').data('post-id');
    $.post('https://temscoair.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php', {
      action: 'password-protected',
      postId: postId,
    }, function(response) {
      let url = new URL(document.location.href);
      let params = new URLSearchParams(url.search);

      if (response) {
        // Post is authed, send to the cached auth version
        params.set('auth', response);
      } else {
        // Post is NOTH authed, remove the param
        params.delete('auth');
      }

      if([...params].length) {
        url = `${location.pathname}?${params}`;
      } else {
        url = location.pathname;
      }

      window.history.replaceState({}, '', url);
    });
  }
</script>

  <script>
          // UUID validation helper
      var isValidUuid = (function(){
        var UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-(?:[0-9a-f]{4}-){3}[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
        return function(uuid){
          return uuid && UUID_REGEX.test(uuid);
        };
      })();

      // Helper to get UUID from localStorage
      var getUuidFromStorage = function() {
        try {
          var uuid = localStorage.getItem('fareharbor-uuid');
          if (uuid) {
            return uuid.replaceAll('"', '');
          }
        } catch(e) {}
        return '';
      };

      // Global flags for tracking identification state
      window.mixpanelIdentified = false;

      // Create a promise that resolves when UUID is available or timeout
      window.mixpanelReady = new Promise(function(resolve) {
        var timeout = window.MIXPANEL_UUID_TIMEOUT || 400;
        var pollInterval = 50;
        var elapsed = 0;

        var checkUuid = function() {
          var uuid = getUuidFromStorage();

          if (uuid && isValidUuid(uuid)) {
            // UUID found - identify and resolve
            window.mixpanel.fareharbor.identify(uuid);
            window.mixpanelIdentified = true;
            resolve();
          } else if (elapsed >= timeout) {
            // Timeout reached - resolve without identifying
            resolve();
          } else {
            // Keep polling
            elapsed += pollInterval;
            setTimeout(checkUuid, pollInterval);
          }
        };

        // Start checking
        checkUuid();
      });
    
    var getMixpanelButtonProperties = function(e) {
      var properties = {
        'destination': $(e).attr('href'),
      };

      if ($(e).data('mixpanel')) {
        properties['link-type'] = $(e).data('mixpanel');
      }

      if ($(e).data('custom-mixpanel-property')) {
        properties['custom-property'] = $(e).data('custom-mixpanel-property');
      }

      let buttonId = $(e).find('span[id]').attr('id');

      if (buttonId) {
        properties['button-id'] = buttonId;
      }

      return properties;
    };

    var sendEventToGTM = function(event, properties) {
        if (window.dataLayer) {
          window.dataLayer.push({
            'event': event,
            'destination': properties['destination'],
            'link-type': properties['link-type'] || null,
            'button-id': properties['button-id'] || null,
            'custom-property': properties['custom-mixpanel-property'] || null
          });
        } else {
          console.error('GTM dataLayer not found.');
        }
      };

    var trackLinkClick = function(e, event) {
              window.mixpanel?.fareharbor.track(event, getMixpanelButtonProperties(e));
                    sendEventToGTM(event, getMixpanelButtonProperties(e));
          };

    FH.autoLightframe({
      overrideOnclick: 'all',
      callback: function(e) {

      
      trackLinkClick(e, 'click-fhme-booking-link');
      }
    });

    $(function() {
      function isExternal(url) {
        if (url.indexOf('http') === -1) {
          return false;
        } else {
          return new URL(url).origin !== window.location.origin;
        }
      }

              // Wait for Mixpanel UUID to be ready before tracking page view
        if (window.mixpanelReady) {
          window.mixpanelReady.then(function() {
            let hasSBD = $('.activity-search').length > 0 ? 'true' : 'false';
            let hasQuickSearch =  $('.quick-search-button').length > 0 ? 'true' : 'false';
            let hasLearnMore =  $('.data-container').data('wants-learn-more') ? 'true' : 'false';
            let hasBookNow =  $('.data-container').data('wants-book-now') ? 'true' : 'false';
            let hasListView = $('.data-container').data('wants-list-view') ? 'true' : 'false';
            let hasIndividualTimes = $('.data-container').data('wants-individual-times') ? 'true' : 'false';
            let hasPublicHeadlines = $('.data-container').data('wants-individual-public-headlines') ? 'true' : 'false';
            let hasDataOnLoad = $('.data-container').data('wants-data-on-load') ? 'true' : 'false';

            if (!hasSBD) {
              window.mixpanel?.fareharbor.track("view-fhme-page", {
                'page-type': document.body.getAttribute('data-mixpanel-type'),
                'page-has-sbd': hasSBD
              });
            } else {
              window.mixpanel?.fareharbor.track("view-fhme-page", {
                'page-type': document.body.getAttribute('data-mixpanel-type'),
                'page-has-sbd': hasSBD,
                'sbd-quick-search': hasQuickSearch,
                'sbd-learn-more': hasLearnMore,
                'sbd-book-now': hasBookNow,
                'sbd-list-view': hasListView,
                'sbd-individual-times': hasIndividualTimes,
                'sbd-public-headlines': hasPublicHeadlines,
                'sbd-data-on-load': hasDataOnLoad
              });
            }
          });
        }
      
      // Set up link click tracking
      $('a').not('[href*="fareharbor.com"]').on('click', function() {
        if (isExternal($(this).attr('href'))) {
          trackLinkClick(this, 'click-fhme-external-link');
        } else {
          trackLinkClick(this, 'click-fhme-internal-link');
        }
      });
    });

  </script>

      }
    }

// Handle query params for activity search
function removeAllQueryParams() {
  const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  if (url.search) {
    window.history.replaceState({}, '', url.pathname + url.hash);
  }
}

function setupUrlCleaner() {
  if (!document.querySelector('.activity-search')) return;
  removeAllQueryParams();

  const origPush = history.pushState;
  const origReplace = history.replaceState;

  history.pushState = function () {
    origPush.apply(this, arguments);
    removeAllQueryParams();
  };

  history.replaceState = function () {
    origReplace.apply(this, arguments);
    removeAllQueryParams();
  };

  window.addEventListener('popstate', removeAllQueryParams);
}

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setupUrlCleaner);

const parentContainer = document.querySelector('.activity-search-content');

if (parentContainer) {
  const parentObserver = new MutationObserver((mutationsList, observer) => {
    const resultsContainer = document.querySelector('.activity-search-results-row');
    if (resultsContainer && !resultsContainer._watching) {
      startWatchingResults(resultsContainer);
      resultsContainer._watching = true;
    }
  });

  parentObserver.observe(parentContainer, { childList: true, subtree: true });
}

function startWatchingResults(resultsContainer) {
  const resultsObserver = new MutationObserver((mutationsList, observer) => {
    observer.disconnect();
    filterAvailabilitiesBasedOnTime();
  });

  resultsObserver.observe(resultsContainer, { childList: true, subtree: true });
}

function isTimeRangeWithinArrivalDeparture(itemId, date, boatArrival, boatDeparture, itemTime) {
  const arrival = new Date(`${date} ${boatArrival}`);
  const departure = new Date(`${date} ${boatDeparture}`);
  
  const bufferedArrival = new Date(arrival.getTime() + arrivalBuffers[itemId] * 60 * 1000);
  const bufferedDeparture = new Date(departure.getTime() - departureBuffers[itemId] * 60 * 1000);

  const [startStr, endStr] = itemTime.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().split(' - ');
  const rangeStart = new Date(`${date} ${startStr}`);

  return rangeStart >= bufferedArrival && rangeStart <= bufferedDeparture;
}

function filterAvailabilitiesBasedOnTime() {
  let line = $('.js-filter-group[data-taxonomy="Cruise Line"] input:checked').siblings('.term-name').text();
  let ship = $('.cruise_line input:checked').siblings('.term-name').text();
  let date = $('.js-filter-group[data-taxonomy="Port Date"] input:checked').siblings('.term-name').text();
  $('.paginationjs-date').text(`${line} - ${ship} - ${date}`);
  let boatArrival = cruiseData[port][line][ship][date.replace(',','')].arrival;
  let boatDeparture = cruiseData[port][line][ship][date.replace(',','')].departure;

  $('.availability-time-button').each(function () {
    const $button = $(this);
    const itemTime = $button.find('.label').text();
    const url = $button.find('a').attr('href');
    const itemId = url.match(/\/items\/(\d+)\/availability/)[1];

    if (!isTimeRangeWithinArrivalDeparture(itemId, date, boatArrival, boatDeparture, itemTime) && !$button.hasClass('availability-time-button-see-more')) {
      $button.hide();

      if (!$button.parents('.grid-activity').find('.availability-time-button').is(':visible')) {
        $button.parents('.grid-activity').hide();
      }
    }
  });

  showNoResultsMessage();
}

function showNoResultsMessage() {
  let $activityGrid = $('.activity-search .activity-grid');
  let showResults = false;

  $activityGrid.find('.grid-activity').each(function() {
    if ($(this).is(':visible')) {
      showResults = true;
    }
  });

  if (!showResults) {
    let $noResults = $('.activity-search-no-results');
    $noResults.html('There are no activities available during your port duration.');
    $noResults.show();
    $activityGrid.hide();
  }
}
</script>

Immerse Yourself in the Wonders of Mendenhall Glacier in Juneau
Take in all the beauty Southeast Alaska has to offer on this once in a life-time helicopter walking tour on the Mendenhall Glacier!
Your tour begins with a short transfer to our comfortable and spacious heli-base. Here you will be geared up with glacier boots and given a safety briefing by our tour attendants. Load up into our state of the art helicopters and begin your bucket-list worthy adventure. Our highly-trained pilots will lift you off the ground and safely transport you over some of the most breathtaking sights you have ever seen. Lush green rainforests, alpine ridges, and glacier valleys pass beneath you as you make your way to the main attraction, the famous Mendenhall Glacier. Before touching down, you will have a birds-eye view of the awe-inspiring blue glacier ice, deep crevasses, spectacular ice falls and the jagged peaks of the Mendenhall Towers.
Once you have safely landed on the glacier you will be welcomed by our team of expert glacier guides. Our knowledgeable guides will take you on a tour of Mendenhall Glacier. During the 25 minutes you spend on the glacier you will learn how glaciers are formed and what makes them so spectacular. The tour will allow you to explore melt-water pools, feel glacial silt, and capture all of the beauty on your camera. The adventure isn’t over yet; join your pilot in the helicopter for a ride back to our base to take in the Alaskan beauty from the air one last time. Leaving the glacier behind you will take with you memories that will last a life-time.
Additional Information
Service Animal Policy
Per TEMSCO Helicopters’ Passenger Mobility Policy, service animals shall not be permitted on Temsco Eurocopter Astar, Hughes 500 and Airbus H130 aircraft used by Temsco for flightseeing and tours. Passenger seats in these aircraft are emergency exit accessible; the exit doors represent the only emergency exits. This policy is consistent with the Air Carrier Access Act that prohibits service animals to be located in an exit aisle.
Surcharge Policy
Due to weight and balance limitations, as well as guest safety and comfort, passengers weighing 250 pounds (113kg or 18 Stone) or more will be charged an additional $150.00 to reserve adequate space on board the helicopter. Total weight includes shoes and clothing. Surcharge must be paid at time of booking.
Baggage Policy
TEMSCO’s policies prohibit the following items on our aircraft/tour:
Bags or cases of any kind
iPads or tablets, tripods
Selfie sticks or other extendible items
Canes or walking sticks
Drones
Water bottles or liquids.
We will provide you with lockers at our base where you may leave such items.
No smoking of any kind is allowed for the duration of the tour.
Transportation
We are happy to provide transportation to our base from the bottom of the Goldbelt/Mount Roberts Tram and select few hotels.
Passenger Ability/Mobility
All TEMSCO excursions are listed as “MODERATE” activity level for the following reasons:
The distance walking from our heli base to the aircraft and the distance from the helicopters to our camp on the glacier. This is approximately 100 feet (30 meters).
The sizeable steps that guests must navigate while getting in and out of the aircraft. These steps are approximately 18” in height.
The natural surface of the glacier can be uneven and cracked
Due to liability reasons, our employees cannot lift guests in or out of the helicopter. TEMSCO staff will be there to lend a helping hand, though ultimately guests are responsible for navigating these steps on their own.
Aircraft Seating
We arrange seating based on the weight, balance, and safety of the whole departure, and cannot guarantee that we will be able to keep groups together on the aircraft. Please note that we will do everything possible to keep groups together for the flight portion of the tour, but we are sometimes required to split a group between multiple helicopters. All groups will be together for the glacier portion of the tour.
Lap Children
A child does not need their own seat if they are under 24 months old on the day that they take the tour. These children are considered a lap child and are free of charge. A parent or guardian is responsible for holding the child securely for the entire tour. Any child 24 months of age or older is required to have their own seat per FAA regulations and therefore will require a full fare ticket for our tour.
Attire
We recommend dressing in warm layers, as clothing is not provided by TEMSCO. Gloves, hats, sunglasses, and a good pair of walking shoes are recommended. We will provide the guests with over-boots for walking on the glacier.
Weather Cancellations
Unfortunately, the weather in Alaska does not always cooperate and there are times when we are unable to fly. If we are unable to fly a tour due to weather, our guests will receive a full refund. In most cases we will not make the decision to cancel a tour until within an hour of departure, as the weather can quickly change and we do not want to preemptively cancel a tour if it is at all possible it will run.

              <div class="extra-content prose">
          <h2>Your Walk of a Lifetime</h2>
<p>Our Helicopter Glacier Walkabout provides a full hour on the glacier to explore, take pictures, and appreciate the magnificent views that surround you. The adventure begins with a short drive to our helicopter base, located next to the Juneau International Airport. We will outfit you in state-of-the-art trekking equipment and give you a safety briefing before you board one of our A-Star helicopters.</p>
<p>Once loaded and ready, it’s time to take off on a Juneau helicopter tour! Experience Juneau’s impressive range of ecosystems while soaring over dramatic mountain ranges, the old-growth trees of the Tongass National Forest, and expansive flows of ice that change from white to vibrant shades of blue, before landing at our base camp on the Mendenhall Glacier. Flight routes depend on the day’s conditions and are up to the pilots.</p>
<p>After carefully unloading, you will meet your guide, who will outfit you with crampons to make it easier to walk on the icy terrain, and a trekking pole for enhanced stability. Once prepared, your guide will lead you on an interpretive Juneau glacier trek to explore the unique features and learn about the local environment.</p>
<p>There will be plenty of time to stop and take pictures of your great adventure before your helicopter returns for your flight back to our heliport. At the end of your tour, our comfortable vans will escort you back to your drop-off point.</p>
<p><strong>Please see FAQ’s page for general information about our tours and safety, <a href="https://northstartrekking.com/faqs/">here</a>.</strong></p>

        </div>

    const postId = $('body').data('post-id');
    $.post('https://northstartrekking.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php', {
      action: 'password-protected',
      postId: postId,
    }, function(response) {
      let url = new URL(document.location.href);
      let params = new URLSearchParams(url.search);

      if (response) {
        // Post is authed, send to the cached auth version
        params.set('auth', response);
      } else {
        // Post is NOTH authed, remove the param
        params.delete('auth');
      }

      if([...params].length) {
        url = `${location.pathname}?${params}`;
      } else {
        url = location.pathname;
      }

      window.history.replaceState({}, '', url);
    });
  }

          // UUID validation helper
      var isValidUuid = (function(){
        var UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-(?:[0-9a-f]{4}-){3}[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
        return function(uuid){
          return uuid && UUID_REGEX.test(uuid);
        };
      })();

      // Helper to get UUID from localStorage
      var getUuidFromStorage = function() {
        try {
          var uuid = localStorage.getItem('fareharbor-uuid');
          if (uuid) {
            return uuid.replaceAll('"', '');
          }
        } catch(e) {}
        return '';
      };

      // Global flags for tracking identification state
      window.mixpanelIdentified = false;

      // Create a promise that resolves when UUID is available or timeout
      window.mixpanelReady = new Promise(function(resolve) {
        var timeout = window.MIXPANEL_UUID_TIMEOUT || 400;
        var pollInterval = 50;
        var elapsed = 0;

        var checkUuid = function() {
          var uuid = getUuidFromStorage();

          if (uuid && isValidUuid(uuid)) {
            // UUID found - identify and resolve
            window.mixpanel.fareharbor.identify(uuid);
            window.mixpanelIdentified = true;
            resolve();
          } else if (elapsed >= timeout) {
            // Timeout reached - resolve without identifying
            resolve();
          } else {
            // Keep polling
            elapsed += pollInterval;
            setTimeout(checkUuid, pollInterval);
          }
        };

        // Start checking
        checkUuid();
      });

Your Walk of a Lifetime
Our Helicopter Glacier Walkabout provides a full hour on the glacier to explore, take pictures, and appreciate the magnificent views that surround you. The adventure begins with a short drive to our helicopter base, located next to the Juneau International Airport. We will outfit you in state-of-the-art trekking equipment and give you a safety briefing before you board one of our A-Star helicopters.
Once loaded and ready, it’s time to take off on a Juneau helicopter tour! Experience Juneau’s impressive range of ecosystems while soaring over dramatic mountain ranges, the old-growth trees of the Tongass National Forest, and expansive flows of ice that change from white to vibrant shades of blue, before landing at our base camp on the Mendenhall Glacier. Flight routes depend on the day’s conditions and are up to the pilots.
After carefully unloading, you will meet your guide, who will outfit you with crampons to make it easier to walk on the icy terrain, and a trekking pole for enhanced stability. Once prepared, your guide will lead you on an interpretive Juneau glacier trek to explore the unique features and learn about the local environment.
There will be plenty of time to stop and take pictures of your great adventure before your helicopter returns for your flight back to our heliport. At the end of your tour, our comfortable vans will escort you back to your drop-off point.
Please see FAQ’s page for general information about our tours and safety, here.
Duration
The total tour duration is 3.25 hours
Tour includes approximately 30 minutes of helicopter time and 1 hour on the glacier
Please book your tour at least one hour after your ship’s arrival time. The tour should conclude no less than 45 minutes before your ship’s departure time. If your ship’s port time changes after you have booked your tour, please contact us.
Highlights
Enjoy sweeping views of the massive Juneau Icefield and Tongass National Forest on your helicopter flight to and from base camp.
Experience some of the glacier’s most stunning features as our guides lead you on an hour-long walking expedition.
Drink pure glacial water straight from the source from one of the many pristine pools you’ll encounter.
Spend time taking in the scenery and capturing perfect photos for memories that are sure to last a lifetime.
Requirements
Must be at least 8 years old to participate.
Must be able to walk unassisted for one hour on moderately flat but uneven terrain.
What's included
We will provide:
Sturdy hiking boots
Sturdy waterproof boots with ankle support.
Glacier traction devices
Making it possible to walk on ice
Trekking Pole
For support & stability while hiking on a glacier
Waterproof Jacket
Shell style jacket that is wind and water resistant
Waterproof Shell Pants
Pants to keep you dry
Gloves
Hip Pack
A place to store your phone, water, snack, and whatever else you may need while on tour with us
Water, And a Light Snack
Professional Glacier Guide
How to Prepare
You should dress for a 10-15°F temperature decrease from sea-level (at the cruise ship docks) to the glacier. We recommend that you dress in long socks, warm layers, and sunglasses.
Baggage Policy
NorthStar’s policies prohibit the following items on our aircraft/tour:
Bags or cases of any kind
iPads or tablets, tripods
Selfie sticks or other extendible items
Drone
Surcharge Policy
Due to weight and balance limitations, as well as guest safety and comfort, passengers weighing 250 pounds (113kg or 18 Stone) or more will be charged an additional $150.00 to reserve adequate space on board the helicopter. Total weight includes shoes and clothing. Surcharge must be paid at time of booking.
Aircraft Seating
We arrange seating based on the weight, balance, safety, and comfort of the whole departure, and cannot guarantee that we will be able to keep groups together on the aircraft. Please note that we will do everything possible to keep groups together for the flight portion of the tour, but we are sometimes required to split a group between multiple helicopters. All groups will be together for the glacier portion of the tour.
Cancellation Policy
If you decide to cancel more than 24 hours before departure, you will receive a refund minus a 10% cancellation fee. If you cancel less than 24 hours before departure, you will not receive a refund.
Weather Cancellations
Weather in Juneau can often be overcast and rainy. Decisions to operate tours are based on safety and tour quality. Should we decide not to operate your scheduled tour we will do our best to reschedule. If this is not possible, you will be refunded in full. In most cases we will not make the decision to cancel a tour until within an hour of departure, as the weather can quickly change and we do not want to preemptively cancel a tour – if it is at all possible it will run.

<script>
    if ($('body').hasClass('post-password-protected')) {
    const postId = $('body').data('post-id');
    $.post('https://northstartrekking.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php', {
      action: 'password-protected',
      postId: postId,
    }, function(response) {
      let url = new URL(document.location.href);
      let params = new URLSearchParams(url.search);

      if (response) {
        // Post is authed, send to the cached auth version
        params.set('auth', response);
      } else {
        // Post is NOTH authed, remove the param
        params.delete('auth');
      }

      if([...params].length) {
        url = `${location.pathname}?${params}`;
      } else {
        url = location.pathname;
      }

      window.history.replaceState({}, '', url);
    });
  }
</script>

  <script>
          // UUID validation helper
      var isValidUuid = (function(){
        var UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-(?:[0-9a-f]{4}-){3}[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
        return function(uuid){
          return uuid && UUID_REGEX.test(uuid);
        };
      })();

      // Helper to get UUID from localStorage
      var getUuidFromStorage = function() {
        try {
          var uuid = localStorage.getItem('fareharbor-uuid');
          if (uuid) {
            return uuid.replaceAll('"', '');
          }
        } catch(e) {}
        return '';
      };

      // Global flags for tracking identification state
      window.mixpanelIdentified = false;

      // Create a promise that resolves when UUID is available or timeout
      window.mixpanelReady = new Promise(function(resolve) {
        var timeout = window.MIXPANEL_UUID_TIMEOUT || 400;
        var pollInterval = 50;
        var elapsed = 0;

        var checkUuid = function() {
          var uuid = getUuidFromStorage();

          if (uuid && isValidUuid(uuid)) {
            // UUID found - identify and resolve
            window.mixpanel.fareharbor.identify(uuid);
            window.mixpanelIdentified = true;
            resolve();
          } else if (elapsed >= timeout) {
            // Timeout reached - resolve without identifying
            resolve();
          } else {
            // Keep polling
            elapsed += pollInterval;
            setTimeout(checkUuid, pollInterval);
          }
        };

        // Start checking
        checkUuid();
      });
    
    var getMixpanelButtonProperties = function(e) {
      var properties = {
        'destination': $(e).attr('href'),
      };

      if ($(e).data('mixpanel')) {
        properties['link-type'] = $(e).data('mixpanel');
      }

      if ($(e).data('custom-mixpanel-property')) {
        properties['custom-property'] = $(e).data('custom-mixpanel-property');
      }

      let buttonId = $(e).find('span[id]').attr('id');

      if (buttonId) {
        properties['button-id'] = buttonId;
      }

      return properties;
    };

    var sendEventToGTM = function(event, properties) {
        if (window.dataLayer) {
          window.dataLayer.push({
            'event': event,
            'destination': properties['destination'],
            'link-type': properties['link-type'] || null,

Frequently Asked Questions
Please review information about our tours and safety measures
All Tours
Do you provide transportation to and from tours?
We provide comfortable van transportation both to and from our Airport and Douglas Bases. Our Helicopter Glacier Walkabout, Trek, and Ice Climbing tours are all dispatched from our base located next to the Juneau International Airport (JNU) in the Mendenhall Valley; while our Taku Glacier Helicopter & Airboat Adventure and Helicopter Glacier Dogsled Adventure are launched from our base on Douglas Island.
We are able to pick up and drop off in most locations in Juneau, excluding the Mendenhall Glacier Recreation Area. Cruise ship passengers who book directly with us rather than through their ship will be picked up and dropped off at the Goldbelt Tramway downtown.
What can I bring on my tour?
Because space in the helicopter is limited, everything that goes with you should fit inside of your pockets. If carrying larger DSLR cameras, we recommend a neck-strap for easy carrying. Bags and purses are not permitted on this tour. We provide safe storage lockers for any personal belongings to remain at our base.
Because space in the helicopter is limited, everything that you bring should fit inside your pockets or the large hip pack that is provided on our trekking tours. For larger DSLR cameras, we recommend a neck-strap for easy carrying. Bags, purses, selfie sticks, nor drones are permitted. We provide safe storage for any personal belongings to remain at our base.
How many people will there be in my helicopter?
We fly A-Star 350 series helicopters that seat up to 6 passengers plus the pilot. Seating is arranged in the helicopter to comply with the helicopter’s weight and balance requirements.
What is your cancellation policy?
If you decide to cancel more than 24 hours before departure, you will receive a refund minus a 10% cancellation fee. If you cancel less than 24 hours before departure, you will not receive a refund.
How do you arrange seating in the aircraft?
We arrange seating based on the weight, balance, safety, and comfort of the whole departure, and cannot guarantee that we will be able to keep groups together on the aircraft. Please note that we will do everything possible to keep groups together for the flight portion of the tour, but we are sometimes required to split a group between multiple helicopters. All groups will be together for the glacier portion of the tour.
Trekking Tours
What should I wear?
You should dress for a 10-15°F temperature decrease from sea-level (at the cruise ship docks) to the glacier. We recommend that you dress in long socks, warm layers, and sunglasses. We will provide you with rain pants, a rain jacket, gloves, a harness, and boots during your tour. Additionally, water and a light snack will be provided for walkabouts, treks, and extended treks.
Which glacier will I be on?
We operate the majority of our trekking tours on the Mendenhall Glacier. However, we also have permits to operate on the Taku, Hole-in-the-Wall, Thiel, Gilkey, Norris, Battle, and Herbert Glaciers. The location is depended upon weather and glacier conditions, with safety and quality of the experience as the top priority.
How difficult will the trip be?
We offer three different levels of treks to accommodate a broad range of physical abilities and time on the glacier.
Walkabout is the easiest and allows for 1-hour on the glacier.
Trek requires a moderate amount of physical activity for 2 hours.
Extended Trek is the most strenuous and allows you to spend 3-hours on the glacier.
Additionally, all tours will be made to accommodate the level of the participants in the group. No previous climbing or glacier experience is needed.
Dogsledding Tour
What should I wear?
You should dress for a 10-15°F temperature decrease from sea-level (at the cruise ship docks) to the glacier. We recommend that you dress in sturdy shoes, long socks, warm layers, gloves, and sunglasses. We will provide you with over boots.
Which glacier will I be on?
We operate all of our dogsledding tours on the Norris Glacier. Unlike the Mendenhall Glacier, which earns its fame for being one of the most accessible glaciers in North America, the Norris Glacier is secluded and well off the beaten path of other visitors. Our remote dog mushers camp is located approximately 35 kilometers outside of Juneau and is only accessible by helicopter. The Norris Glacier is massive, extending from over 4,000 feet in elevation down to the coastline, where visitors may have the fortune to view stunning displays of azure-blue ice walls as the glacier calves into the sea, while en route to dog camp.
Airboat Tour
What should I wear?
You should dress for a 10-15°F temperature decrease from sea-level (at the cruise ship docks) to the glacier. We recommend that you dress in sturdy shoes, long socks, warm layers, gloves, and sunglasses. We will provide you with over boots and rain pants during your tour.
Which glacier will I be on?
We operate all of our airboat tours on the Taku Glacier. The Taku is a massive tidewater glacier and the largest of 38 glaciers comprising the 1,500 square mile Juneau Icefield. The Taku Inlet region remains, to this day, one of the most pristine and untouched areas of Southeast Alaska. Due to the shallow river banks, the inlet is only accessible by careful boat navigation or by air. Our base at Taku Point is the area’s only visible human structure, allowing you to view this environment in its rawest form.
